rankings.strongest_test: Longitudinal single-cell multiome of APCs in EBV-seroconverters tracking IFN-stimulated gene module and HLA-II peptidome before/after MS or SLE onset, with Mendelian randomization on HLA-DRB1*15:01 and IFIH1 variants
rankings.fatal_weakness: EBV near-ubiquity and shared IFN signatures across autoimmunity make disease-specific causal attribution difficult

rankings.strongest_test: Anti-CD20 and anti-BAFF trial substudies correlating memory B-subset depletion kinetics with Tfh/Th17 contraction and MRI relapse hazard
rankings.fatal_weakness: Remodeling may be downstream consequence of inflammation rather than gating event

rankings.strongest_test: Serial CyTOF/scRNA of monocyte-DC HLA-DR/CD64 modules across pregnancy trimesters and 0–6 months postpartum linked to gadolinium-enhancing lesion timing
rankings.fatal_weakness: Small postpartum cohorts and confounding by hormonal, lactation, and DMT-washout effects limit causal inference

rankings.strongest_test: CSF C3/C1q and oxysterol panels in PIRA vs RAW progressors with PET-TSPO and slowly-expanding-lesion MRI, plus complement-inhibitor trial readout
rankings.fatal_weakness: Complement and lipid changes are nonspecific to progression and overlap with aging/neurodegeneration broadly

rankings.strongest_test: Cathepsin/AEP activity and HLA-II ligandome profiling in patient monocyte-derived DCs ± lysosomal modulators, testing altered MBP/EBV epitope presentation
rankings.fatal_weakness: No robust human genetic or pharmacologic signal implicating lysosomal processing specifically in MS

rankings.strongest_test: Mendelian randomization on HMGCR, SREBF, and bile-acid loci against MS susceptibility and progression, plus simvastatin/clemastine remyelination trial biomarkers
rankings.fatal_weakness: Statin and lipid MR data to date show weak, inconsistent effects on MS incidence, undermining a causal setpoint model
